source.title: Forebears Rwanda forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to replace the legacy seed with localized name pools. Generated names are samples, not civil-registry identities.

source.title: Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority national numbering plan

phones.notes: RURA publishes Rwanda country code +250 and national numbering allocations. Generated numbers use public mobile-style leading digits and are not checked for live assignment or portability.

locations.notes: City address records are map-reference samples of public places checked on 2026-07-31. postalCode is copied only when the map source provides one; PO Box and Plus Code values are not used as postalCode. The location block source gives country-level address context; each address record carries its own map source.

national_identity_number.label: National Identity Number

source.title: World Bank Rwanda ID4D Diagnostic: 16-digit National Identity Number

national_identity_number.notes: World Bank confirms a 16-digit NIN printed on the card. Generated values are random 16-digit test values only; no semantic groups, checksum, uniqueness, or registry validation is implemented.

passport.label: Passport
passport.notes: PRADO confirms a valid Rwanda ordinary passport document version, but no public passport-number grammar was found. The letter-plus-eight-digits template remains an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.
